faqs.answer:
📚 Basic Certificate in Dental Assisting

Thank you for your interest in our 2-Day Basic Certificate in Dental Assisting. This beginner-friendly, practical course introduces essential skills such as recognising dental instruments and materials, infection control, and how to anticipate a dentist’s needs during procedures.

Course details:
- Course fee: S$600 nett
- Duration: Two consecutive training days
- Training hours: 9:30am to 5:30pm on each day
- Venue: The exact training venue will be confirmed for your selected intake

You can find more details at https://qandm.edu.sg/Courses/Dental-Assistant/4/Basic-Certificate-In-Dental-Assisting. Basic-tier SkillsFuture Credits may be used for the course fee.

Would you like to learn more about the course or begin an enrolment? 😊

📚 Course Fee and Schedule

The course fee is S$600 nett.

- Duration: Two consecutive training days

- The fee includes comprehensive course materials, instruction from experienced trainers, and access to specialised equipment and facilities

Thank you for sharing your concern about the course fee. We understand that cost is an important consideration, and we aim to ensure that our pricing reflects the quality and value of the education and resources provided.

📚 The S$600 nett fee for the two-day course includes:

- Comprehensive course materials
- Instruction from experienced trainers
- Access to specialised equipment and facilities
- Practical knowledge that supports professional development

We believe the course can provide valuable skills for participants interested in dental assisting. We also appreciate your concern and will take it into consideration for future planning.

If there is a particular part of the course or fee that you would like to understand better, please feel free to ask 😊

Use the configured intake list. If it is empty, return the no_intakes_message exactly and do not invent a date.

SkillsFuture Credits

There are two tiers of SkillsFuture Credits. This course is eligible only for basic-tier SkillsFuture Credits. Mid-Career SkillsFuture Credits cannot be used for the course fee.

You may check your basic-tier balance at https://sfc.myskillsfuture.gov.sg/claim and let us know how much you intend to use. You will need to submit your own claim. After receiving your enrolment and payment details, the team will prepare an invoice and email you the claim steps.

Would you like help with the enrolment details?

Mid-Career SkillsFuture Credits

There are two tiers of SkillsFuture Credits. This course is eligible only for basic-tier SkillsFuture Credits. Mid-Career SkillsFuture Credits cannot be used to pay the course fee.

You can check your basic-tier SkillsFuture Credit balance at https://sfc.myskillsfuture.gov.sg/claim.

Would you like to know how to use your basic-tier credits for enrolment?

💳 PayNow Payment

PayNow is accepted using UEN 201841969G.

If you are also using basic-tier SkillsFuture Credits, please tell us:
- The SkillsFuture amount you intend to use
- The remaining amount that you will pay by PayNow

The two amounts must total the S$600 nett course fee. Would you like help with the payment breakdown?

UTAP Funding Support

Eligible NTUC Union members may receive support for 50% of the unfunded course fee, up to S$250 per year. NTUC members aged 40 and above may receive up to S$500 per year.

How to apply:

1. Confirm that your NTUC Union membership is valid. You can check by chatting with NTUC at https://ntuc.co/chat or logging in to the NTUC U Portal at https://www.ntuc.org.sg.
2. Enrol in the course, pay the course fee upfront, and attend both training days.
3. After completing the course, log in to the NTUC U Portal and submit your UTAP claim.

Documents required:
- Proof of payment, such as the course invoice or receipt
- Proof of completion, such as the certificate or results slip

Both documents will be provided after the course. Please submit the claim within six months of course completion, as late submissions will not be accepted. UTAP cannot be combined with SkillsFuture Credits for the same course fee.

Would you like help with the enrolment process?

✅ Minimum Qualification

GCE N Levels are preferred. If you do not have GCE N Levels, you may still be considered if you have basic English reading and writing skills, as the assessment is conducted in English.

Would you like to learn more about the course or enrolment requirements? 😊

Employment Opportunities

Suitable candidates may be considered for job opportunities on the last day of the class. The HR selection process considers several factors:

- Workplace location
- Work schedule
- Skills and experience
- Suitability and cultural fit
- Interview performance

Employment is not guaranteed and will depend on the selection process.

Would you like to know more about the skills covered by the course? 😊

💳 Payment Methods

There are three approved payment options:

1. Basic-tier SkillsFuture Credits
   Mid-Career SkillsFuture Credits cannot be used for this course. Any remaining course fee may be paid by PayNow.

2. PayNow
   Please use UEN 201841969G.

3. UTAP reimbursement
   Eligible NTUC Union members must pay the course fee upfront and apply for reimbursement after completing the course.

SkillsFuture Credits and UTAP cannot be combined for the same course fee.

Would you like help choosing a payment option? 😊

Enrolment Information

To register, please provide the following details:

1. Full name as shown on your NRIC
2. NRIC or FIN number
3. Date of birth
4. Email address
5. Mobile number
6. Preferred intake date, or Awaiting confirmation while dates are being updated
7. Payment method
8. SkillsFuture amount, where applicable
9. PayNow amount, where applicable

Only basic-tier SkillsFuture Credits can be used. You may send all the details in one message. Any missing or invalid information will be requested without asking you to repeat valid details. A confirmation summary will be shown before submission.

Invoice and Claim Guidance

After the required enrolment and payment details are received, the team will prepare an invoice and email it together with the relevant payment or SkillsFuture claim instructions.
